fusions.name: Ridden to a Standstill
fusions.desc: Runs a tiring target down with a blow that deals 18 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It only strikes a target at or below 30% health. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Lunge Ring
fusions.desc: Churns a ring of earth around you, dealing 6 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. It holds 5 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Long Haul Breath
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Dray Beast Alongside
fusions.desc: A bonded heidel hauls spoil beside you and fights, striking enemies within 3 tiles for 5 damage every 1.8 seconds. Anything it strikes moves 15% slower for 2 seconds. You can ride it.
